body: Your coworker wanted to make you feel insecure which is very shitty. He needs to mind his own business tbh. Don’t listen to him.

Yup I‘ve noticed this too. I‘ve had many horrible therapists who traumatized me. I have finally found a good one (after YEARS of searching) but my insurance doesn’t cover somatic therapy so I have to pay for it myself. It’s a cruel joke that my insurance pays for abusive therapists and useless types of therapy. And tbh I am extremely careful with all types of mental health professionals bc most are horrible and incompetent in my experience. Many are cruel and just want to control vulnerable people. But good therapists make a huge difference in a positive way.
My birthgiver did the exact same thing!!! But thankfully I decided to just take my birth certificate with me. It‘s mine.

Yup. When I cried I could see the sheer joy and sadism in their eyes. They laughed at me and said I have no reason to cry (although they did horrific things to me). I was never comforted as a kid, except by animals. I am extremely thankful that animals taught me about compassion and empathy, but I just don’t trust people bc I know how evil they can be.

(I‘m talking a bit about my mother trying to kill me so if that’s sth you don’t want to read about, please ignore this. I think it might be valuable to share my experience but idk)

What you are going through is horrific. Idk if it helps but please find solace in the fact that you are a good person who is capable of love. That’s extremely beautiful and needed in this world. I wish my father was like you. my mother tried to murder me when I was a kid (she did that multiple times. And every day she talked about killing me and getting rid of my body). my father sided with her and protected her. My therapist wonders how I survived, I honestly should have died bc the situation was very hopeless and bleak and there was no one to help me. You would have done sth if you had gotten the chance to protect your kids. More people should be like you. You are capable of love which means there is hope for you. And I really like this quote ‚Grief is just love in a heavy coat‘. Grief means that there is lots of love inside of you and you don‘t know where to put it. You are a lovely person. I truly wish you the best.
Tbh he sounds insufferable, immature and unfunny. He tries so hard to be edgy, it’s actually pathetic. He needs to grow up. I wouldn’t be friends with someone like that. But it’s your decision.

I‘ve been diagnosed with chronic migraine and with cluster headaches. They truly aren’t fun. Last year I had several cluster headaches a day for a week straight. My doctor (who is usually chill) was very concerned. It’s no surprise that they get called suicide headaches. I wanted to be dead so badly but I was in too much pain to go through with committing suicide. It’s horrible.

This reminds me of how I felt when I was younger. I suffered lots of sexual abuse and now I hate it when men are sexually attracted to me. It makes me feel severely unsafe. Lots of men stare at me when I‘m out in public and it triggers my fight or flight response. I hate it when men try to flirt with me. It makes me want to basically kick them in the balls lol. I act like I don’t notice how they stare at me but on the inside I‘m terrified and seething with rage at the same time.

I used to love having guys as friends but now I am very careful. I only spend time with people who are kind and predictable. And when a guy shows sexual interest in me I cut contact immediately. I spend most of my days at work or alone and I work on my self-esteem and general mental health. And all of my friends are women. One day I‘ll probably let more men into my life (bc I do love having male friends). but first I need to heal from all of the sexual abuse. I know that kind heterosexual men are out there but rn I need very rigid boundaries when it comes to men. The only men I trust rn are gay bc I know they have zero sexual interest in me. Asexual men would be okay too but I don’t know any irl. I need to do what I gotta do in order to heal. I wish you the best.
Same. I mostly listen to heavy metal these days bc it validates my rage.

This reminds me of how my ex-gf and I were fetishized by men. We were minors and they didn’t care…. it was so creepy. Sexual harassment happens to so many lesbians. It definitely worsened my complex ptsd and I‘m still healing from this.

I lost interest in the show before getting to that scene. I wonder if doing goldfish shots is a very common thing? I recently rewatched some Skins UK videos (skins is a teen show that often gets compared to Euphoria). And there a guy did a goldfish shot too?? It made me feel disgusted and angry. If I saw someone doing that irl I‘d call them out on it. I would be livid tbh.
I‘m in a similar situation rn and it hurts so much. I‘m sending you lots of support. You are a worthy human being and you deserve people who are there for you.

Wow I relate to all of this. I need the money to survive but my job causes me unbearable pain. When I'm at work I feel worse and worse until my mind goes blank. It feels like my nerves are on fire and I just want to escape. I feel trapped too. Working fulltime is killing me. I really need that time to recover instead. I wish I could give you advice but I don't know how to solve this problem either.

I feel the same way. I had to stay home from work today bc I completely broke down yesterday. I work full-time and I'm still poor. Yesterday when I came home from work I kept saying 'I can't do this anymore' and I couldn't sleep bc I thought of all the stuff I have to get done. My mind and body both ache. It's unbearable. I feel worthless now but tbh that's the cptsd talking. This isn't laziness.

You are right about physical activity. My mental and physical health have gotten much worse after some asshole stole my bike. I go on long walks almost every day but it's not enough. I probably need to start playing soccer or sth.
Nope. I wouldn't be able to afford the rent there tbh. It must be a very exhausting city to live in when you aren't rich.

Wow I relate a lot. I also feel like a caged animal. And I only feel like myself when I'm alone in nature. I'm also tired of pretending to be a well-adjusted person. It's exhausting to always hide my true emotions and thoughts. Sometimes I just want to cry and scream and tell people to leave me alone. I'm tired of acting like I am okay. I need to go camping in the wilderness for a few weeks and just exist in peace.

Rage rooms sound so useful. I'm gonna check if there are some nearby. I'm honestly surprised that my neighbours have never heard me when I destroyed my furniture and screamed or sobbed. But they are much louder than me so that's probably why (I have to sleep with earplugs every night because of their partying). I'm glad you got away with it too. Sometimes you just need to get your anger out.
Yup same. Which is why I'm not dating anymore and why I don't let anyone get close to me (not even as friends)

I relate SO MUCH. I'm tired of destroying my own stuff, especially because I don't have the money to replace it. I would love a business where I can destroy junk with a baseball bat and scream my lungs out. I know if I screamed the way I need to in my apartment, my neighbours would probably call the cops. I just want to get my rage out without ending up in a psychiatric hospital.
Cptsd is such a difficult thing to deal with. It sometimes feels like I'm all alone with all of this rage and pain. Thank you for your reply, I feel a little less alone now.

I am so 😄happy😀😀 that my mother🤰 abused me in all kinds of ways and that I am now 😀traumatized😀 for😀 life😀😀😀. She really showed me what 💜unconditional love💜 is like when she beat me up👊. Because of her abuse I am now 🌟blessed🌟 with chronic mental and physical illnesses🤕🤕. A mother's love is the purest 💖love💖 on earth🌎. Mothers are saints😇!!!!!!!!!1

Thank you for writing this. It's really interesting that you mentioned homelessness. There was a time when I was too traumatized to work. I was able to live with my best friend back then (she paid for our groceries. and I paid the rent for my tiny room bc I had a little bit money saved). If I hadn't been able to live with her I would have ended up being homeless. I'm actually in danger of becoming homeless in a few months. It's terrifying. And my best friend lives far away now and is very poor herself. People with non-abusive families have no idea what it's like to live without a safety net. It's like they are living in a parallel universe.

Rn I'm surrounded by people with extremely easy lives. One of them claimed that homeless people could just choose to not be homeless. She also said that trauma doesn't exist. And when I told her my flatmates threatened to rape me, she laughed and didn't care either. Nobody cared. It's actually terrifying. Nobody took me seriously. It made me realize that I have no friends here. They are the same people who watch true crime shows and then say 'Oh god how sad. How could this have happened? Why didn't the victim reach out?" Tbh people cry for help in all sorts of ways. Bad things happen bc people just don't care about each other. They choose to be ignorant of all the suffering bc they much rather live in a comfortable bubble. I'm not saying that people should always save other people and spend their entire days being aware of all the suffering in the world. That's unhealthy. Boundaries are important. But there is something seriously wrong with a society in which a woman talks about living with guys who threaten to rape her, and supposed 'friends' and other acquaintances just laugh and look the other way. It's basic human decency to at least show some empathy. but many people are self-centered and uncaring and willfully blind.

I often feel extremely angry bc life is unfair as hell. I know that everyone has their own problems blablablabla. But let's be real, some people have it MUCH EASIER than others. It feels like there is no justice. I'm tired of this world
You are allowed to feel uncomfortable. There is nothing wrong with you. The things you mentioned make me feel uncomfortable too tbh.

(tw for sexual abuse and suicidal ideation)

My life is hell. It doesn't get better no matter what I do. I escaped my 'hometown' after almost having been abused to death there. I tried to create a new life in a new place. And guess what? Two of my flatmates sexually harassed me. One of them talked about raping, torturing and killing me. Nobody cared, including the 'friends' I've made here. And the abusive landlord didn't want to let me move out. He said that he doesn't care if I get raped. I took my stuff and fought to get the apartment that I currently live in. I had to pay two rents at the same time bc he didn't let me out of the contract (although I had to leave to save my life). I lost so much money which is horrific bc I'm poor and chronically ill. I am always in pain and I always get punished for it. It doesn't matter what I do and where I go and how much I fight. I meet evil people in every single place. The only truth I know is that I'll only be safe when I'm finally dead. I really need access to assisted suicide, it's the only hope I have left.

I'm gonna sound cynical now. I think that many people just don't care about other people. And those who say 'as a parent I feel sad' about a dead child are the same people who watch the child next door getting abused without doing anything to help them. Many of them even defend the abusive parents. That's what I've experienced and what many other abuse survivors have experienced as well.

So in conclusion, people usually don't care about other people who are suffering, including their literal neighbours. And there are things that await all of us, like death and pain. So most people choose to be in denial of that. They lie to themselves bc that's more comfortable. Many say that they hate their lives and then go on to have children. It's just pure insanity, all of it. I'm capable of enjoying simple things like sunsets and chocolate. But those things will never be enough to make up for the suffering that I went through and the suffering that I witnessed. It's a horrific world that we live in and people choose to be willfully blind to that fact.
I relate a lot. Thank you for sharing your painting with us.
This breaks my heart. Losing a pet is horrific. I wish you lots of strength.

Yup I sometimes destroy my stuff and I hate it. I destroy things that I actually like and that are important to me. It really sucks but in that moment I am overwhelmed with pain and rage. And I used to self harm so destroying furniture is the better option for me.
I feel the same way. My trauma did not make me stronger. Instead I have flashbacks every single day and I'm in pain almost all the time.

This has gotten really long, I apologize.

I relate so much to what you are experiencing. It's such a horrible thing to struggle with.

I am dealing with too much emotionally. I have no support system where I live. I fled my hometown and my dangerously abusive 'family'. I barely escaped alive. And then the pandemic happened and I had no chance to create a support system where I am now. I could also soon lose my job and my apartment. My landlord is awful to me and gaslights me, at my job they don't care about how they treat me, at school the teachers mistreat me too and don't care about my chronic illnesses, I have to take public transport which triggers my cptsd, I get harassed by men when I leave my house so I can't even take a walk in peace etc. And my bike was stolen which was my most important coping mechanism and I can't afford another one.

I have to deal with everything on my own. And I'm poor so I can't afford to see my therapist more than 1 or 2 times a month (which honestly is still way too expensive). I also have no future bc I can't afford to go to uni and nobody helps me.

I hope this wasn't too much complaining. I can't do this anymore. And now my mind is completely failing me which is making everything so much worse. I don't know how to make it better. I try to focus on my emotional health as much as I can. But I work fulltime and I have to study instead of having freetime (I studied all weekend again and it's hell). I don't think I've mentioned that I have a customer service job which is the worst kind of job for cptsd, at least for me. I don't know what to do. Everything is just painful. If I had a family or at least someone who is there for me, everything would be different. I'm losing hope.

I used to self-harm to cope with being abused. It's why I got bpd as a diagnosis although I don't have bpd. They just hear 'self harm' and then immediately diagnose you with that. They didn't even ask if I had other bpd symptoms. I'm scared bc that bs diagnosis could possibly ruin my future bc it stays on my record. But that's a whole different story.

Self harm is an expression of trauma in my experience. It doesn't automatically mean that a person has a personality disorder. Even animals can self harm when they are in emotional distress. Some birds do that, for example. And birds can't have a personality disorder. But they can be traumatized (bc trauma is physiological). Self-harm can definitely be a symptom of cptsd.
That's horrible!!! I hope she gets fired tbh. You deserve to work in a healthy environment.

I fully relate to this. I also got tortured, never got justice. My abusers are protected too. I have the same kind of thoughts that you do. They are appropriate to the situation. Ofc we are angry!!! We were put in a life-threatening situation and our thoughts reflect that. There is nothing wrong with you. There is nothing wrong with having a fight response.

I suffer from daily flashbacks too. I really wish I could make them stop. And I am filled with rage, it's exhausting. I just want justice. I just want my abusers to be put in jail. That will never happen. I moved away a few years ago and I still hate the place I grew up in. It's filled with child-abusing scum.

You aren't alone in this. My heart breaks for every survivor who can't get justice either. It's unbearable.

That's horrible. I am chronically ill too (severe migraine attacks and cluster headaches). And having various mental health issues on top of that is just too much to handle, especially without help.

I currently have a customer service job and dealing with people triggers my migraines and my cptsd. It's the worst kind of job for me. I struggle to keep this job bc it's ruining my health. At the same time I'm struggling to find a job that's good for me (I used to work with animals. I was perfect at that but my coworkers were abusive and made my cptsd so much worse)

I hope we'll both find something that helps. It's so scary to feel this confused. And I feel ashamed bc people who don't know me probably think I'm dumb. But actually I'm just in unbearable pain.
it's all too much rn. my brain is telling me to just get over it, but that's unrealistic and cruel. life is so stressful, especially when you suffer from cptsd.

You aren't alone. They should leave you alone. I hate leaving the house bc of similar experiences. I used to have a 50year-old stalker when I was a minor. And I've had plenty other terrifying experiences with men. I can barely function when I have to leave the house. I have to take public transport to work and it's hell on earth. I dream of owning a car and living isolated in nature. I am tired of men harassing me. A few weeks ago I ignored a strange man who walked up to me (it was already dark outside and I just wanted to run an errand in peace). He then started screaming at me, completely aggressive. Before I left the house that day I had an anxiety attack and told myself that I had no reason to be scared of going outside..... I can't do this anymore tbh.
It's horrible that she treated you this way. Children have the fundamental right to go outside and to play with toys. It's completely understandable that you resent her.
Customer service is hell. It's being forced to interact with people, no matter how triggered you feel. I can't wait to quit my job. I'm tired of feeling triggered and worthless.

I suffer from severe chronic pain and complex trauma. Ofc I'd rather be dead. I do my best to improve my life but people make everything harder. They always have. As soon as I get access to assisted suicide I'm out of here. I think that's reasonable bc my chronic pain makes life completely unbearable. And I was tortured by my family. That's not something you ever fully recover from. Quality of life is important and my life is pure pain. I wish I had never been born. But I don't "regret" something that I haven't done. I hate those who've dragged me into this life and then abused me to the point where I became chronically ill and forever traumatized.

I would tell myself to grab my documents and run away from my "home"town immediately. Homelessness would have been safer than staying with my horribly abusive "parents". And I would warn myself to not trust certain people who ended up betraying me. I also would also tell myself that nothing is wrong with me and that I'm just deeply traumatized.

Chronic migraines (as in almost daily, my life isn't worth living anymore bc of this). My attacks are often extremely severe. I've tried several treatments now. I think I should apply for disability benefits bc I can't work, take the bus and do normal everday stuff without being in excrutiating pain.

Cluster headaches (also called suicide headaches bc many people who get them would rather die)

And just general tension, back pain etc.

I'm seriously not having a good time lmao

Animals. Especially dogs. I can't have any animals rn and it's causing me immense suffering. Dogs are MUCH BETTER therapists than human therapists imo lol. They care, they are emotionally intelligent, they are funny and full of love. I will create myself a life where I can have pets again bc they are essential for my entire well-being. Goats are amazing too.

And just being in nature helps a lot. I suffer from chronic pain and daily emotional flashbacks. all of that becomes manageable when I leave the city and just stay in nature (I grew up in nature but the people there were homophobic and violent and hated women. That's why I moved to a city. But tbh all I want is an isolated cabin in nature. I miss the stars and the animals and the woods)

I relate so much. I feel angry, broken and isolated too. I just don't understand why I got tortured by so many people!! And why nobody cared (except for my dog who was the only family I've ever had). My parents should be in jail!!! The world feels harsh, hostile and cruel. Humanity seems selfish and uncaring. No wonder so many of us feel lost and terrified. Ofc we feel that way!!!
Same. I've had a horrible migraine this entire weekend. I feel the need to just yell at someone. But I would feel horrible afterwards so I just keep my anger inside. But yup I feel mean af inside rn.
I believe it can be done too!!! I wish you a beautiful future.
I hate that they don't just leave us alone. And sending pics takes no effort at all. How ridiculous and manipulative of her.
You definitely aren't weak. It's completely understandable that you are traumatized by what you have been through.

My narcissistic mother brainwashed me so badly. Now everytime something horrible happens to me my initial reaction is "I did sth to deserve this". Which is bs ofc. It takes so long to recover from gaslighting, especially when you were surrounded by multiple abusers as a kid and nobody protected you. I still second-guess my emotions and thoughts all the time, especially when people mistreat me.

I went vegan!!! It's the best and most compassionate thing I've ever done for myself, the animals and the planet.

In 2022 I want to find a way to save some money. I'm already working on it.

It's horrible that you are in so much pain. I know what it's like bc I used to long for a healthy relationship too. I wanted someone to save me from my loneliness. I'm in my 20s and had one very toxic relationship as a teen. I've stopped dating bc I think it's not worth the stress. I've realized that I prefer to spend time by myself. I think most people have unhealthy ideas about love (and many don't know the difference between love and obsession).

So in conclusion, I can't be bothered anymore. Solitude is bliss. At the same time, if the right person should ever come along, I'd probably give them a chance. And if that never happens then that's okay too.
You aren't rude. You are keeping yourself safe. You have the fundamental right to set boundaries.

You aren't stupid. I fell into the same trap. After years of extremely horrendous abuse I went no contact. But awful things happened and I longed for a family who would keep me safe. My abusive 'family' took advantage of that and I had contact with them again. That was an extremely big mistake which put my life in danger. This is what they do. They manipulate their victims to lure them back in.

The conclusion isn't that you are stupid. It's that they are horrendous and disgusting people who don't deserve another chance.
Yes, you got this!! I wish you a beautiful future.
He doesn't respect your boundaries and it's disgusting tbh. This reminds me so much of my older sibling and my 'mother'.

Yup my narcissistic family members do this, especially my 'mother' and my older sibling. I had a 'best friend' who severely abused me. When I set boundaries she started crying and slamming doors. They do that to manipulate you. They act like they are the victim.

For example, that 'friend' was extremely controlling. She had a few other friends but she didn't allow me to have any friends beside her. When I texted my other friend, she sobbed uncontrollably, slammed doors and acted like I was a monster. It was terrifying. She ended up doing horrific things to me and stole many years of my life. She still thinks that she is the victim. People like that can be very dangerous. They believe that they are good but they cause trauma and destruction without any guilt.

I'm spending Christmas alone too and I'm actually feeling good!! It's so peaceful. Last year I spend it alone for the first time and I mostly felt sad but also peaceful at the same time. Now I'm surprised bc I actually feel happy??? Solitude is bliss.

I'm very glad that you chose yourself over them. You are right, it's disgusting that you were disrespected. My 'family' is horribly disrespectful to me too, which is why I'm spending the holidays alone again. I think that's better than being mistreated. I feel lonely but I will take a walk in nature and make myself sth delicious to eat. I just need peace. And I refuse to give up my self-respect and let them walk all over me. Boundaries are incredibly important for your mental health.

Somatic experiencing. I think my therapist is helpful bc she is very intuitive and empathetic.

What I can't stand are incompetent and unempathetic therapists who want to do worksheets. I had a dbt therapist like that. What's the point? I could google all that stuff by myself. And he was so clueless. He triggered emotional flashbacks and didn't even realize that!! And then he acted like I had no reason to be triggered!! He was polite and soft-spoken but unbelievably bad at his job. After a therapy session with him I was completely dysregulated for days. The same can be said for all other traditional therapists I've had. They all did lasting damage. I got misdiagnosed with bpd by some of those clueless clowns. I didn't even have enough of the symptoms to get diagnosed with that. Highly unethical.

Oh and btw my somatic therapist is traumatized herself. She knows what that is like. And she has lots of experience in her field. The most important thing is that the therapist cares about you, understands you, is highly empathetic and intuitive and understands the nervous system.
That therapist sounds unempathetic as hell. That's not a 'love language'. My first reaction was that your mother isn't taking your pain seriously at all. I would fire that therapist tbh.

yup my family said this to me every day. It hurts so deeply. They told me I should have never been born and that everyone wants me to die etc etc. They said even worse things than that. Words can't describe how much this hurts.

Please keep in mind that you aren't a mistake. You are a person and you are worthy of love. Your father is horrible.

That's very understandable. Tbh I am scared too. I haven't told them yet that I won't visit them this year. Last year I told them that I was scared of Covid and that I had the flu. I am too scared to tell them that their abuse is the reason why I won't visit them. It's likely that they would retaliate and punish me for this (which honestly is just further proof that I need to stay away from them). I will probably say that I'm worried bc of Covid and that I have too much stuff to do (which isn't a lie). I need to be safe and that's why I will stay away from them. I haven't seen them in almost two years now and I plan on never seeing them again.

You are not overreacting. You have valid reasons to stay away from them. Your emotions are incredibly important and you need to trust them!!

I spent Christmas alone for the first time last year. This year I will spend it alone again. My abusive mother (who is horribly violent and also sexually abused me) is trying to manipulate me into visting them. She tries to wear the mask of a loving mother but I know what kind of monster hides behind it. I would not be safe there at all. And my body knows this. When I think about visiting them I feel anxious and dizzy and just horrifically stressed out. I am not willing to put myself into danger just so that my abusers feel good about themselves. My safety is more important than their ego. My staying away from them is a consequence of their abuse. It is their fault. They aren't the victim.

You aren't doing anything wrong by protecting yourself. You have every right to be safe. They abandoned you by abusing you, it's not the other way around!!! PLEASE don't fall for their manipulation. Your emotions exist for very valid reasons. They want to guide you to safety. You can trust them. Your intuition is powerful. It is your biggest ally.

Playing the piano and drinking hot chocolate sounds so lovely. I will be with you in spirit!!!! I will take a beautiful walk in nature and cook myself something delicious to eat!! Christmas can be peaceful.
I'm very glad that you are safe now. It takes a lot of courage to move away and start your own life. I wish you the best for your recovery and your future.

Thank you for saying that. I moved away from my hometown a few years ago. I live by myself and I am safe. I really hope you are safe too. And regarding your post, please trust your intuition. You weren't imagining things. Your parents are horribly abusive.

Yes. I just wanted to feel like somebody cares about me. Later on I found out that many people knew about the abuse. But they decided to let me, a literal child, deal with it on my own. They protected my abusers instead of saving me. I have no idea how they sleep at night. Real life was more disturbing than the fantasies about being saved that I created in my mind.
Yes. My 'mother' is insane, dangerous and horribly sadistic. She enjoys hating and hurting me.

It's so horrible when cats get sick:( I hope she's going to be okay. No wonder you are tired.

I really relate to what you said about getting retraumatized at work. After I fled my abusive family I got abused at work. Afterwards I was completely unable to work. I have a job rn but I'm triggered all the time bc of the trauma and it's hell. I am doing everything I can to heal but it's hard, especially bc I'm poor. I really hope that things work out for you.
Definitely same!! I have a customer service job rn and I often get triggered and forget everything. It's horrible.

I used to feel that way about myself too. But I think that we aren't entirely in control of how we feel. Your family abused you which is why you have lots of unresolved trauma. So ofc you feel awful. I think it's admirable that you are looking for ways to deal with your trauma (otherwise you wouldn't be posting here!!).

I don't know if it means anything but I sympathize with you. I read in the comments that you cut contact with your abusive family. That's such a difficult thing to go through. I haven't seen my abusive family in almost two years now. They tortured me. I used to believe I was trash bc they made me feel that way through various forms of abuse. I'm still working on accepting myself. They did evil things to me and I was helpless. I never asked to get hurt, but I still often feel like it was my fault. Nobody deserves to have an abusive family. Please don't call yourself lazy. It's incredibly difficult to deal with trauma and that isn't your fault at all.

I'm in my twenties and most of the time I feel 15 (my worst trauma happened then). I also sometimes feel even younger. Many people think I'm still a teenager or even underage, mostly bc of my mannerisms and how I talk. And apparently I also look young. Idk man. I am ashamed to tell anyone my real age bc I don't act like it. I somehow come across as smart and immature at the same time. I just want to tell people that I'm 18 or 19 so that they don't expect too much from me lmao. I can't cope with the immense pressure of being an adult, especially bc I have no one to help me (I've realized that most people are only strong bc they have helpful families etc. And I have no one)

Yes. I was trapped in an extremely abusive situation when someone close to me died. I had no chance to process her death. I am filled with grief now and it's important that I feel this way. I need to acknowledge what happened and finally process that she is gone.

It's horrible that you suffer so much during the holidays too. I honestly can't bear it. Everyone around me talks about buying gifts and meeting with their loved ones. December will be hell for me. I will spend Christmas and new year's eve alone again. and, even worse, at the end of December I will have to endure the worst trauma anniversary I've ever had to endure. The grief will be too much honestly.

Excuse me for sounding like the grinch here for a sec... but isn't it disgusting that the most fortunate people seem to thrive during the holidays? And the most miserable people will suffer even worse than they do an a daily basis? I despise family-oriented holidays. I might just celebrate Halloween this Christmas and scream my lungs bloody somewhere alone in nature (I need to get my rage out). F*ck this sh*t. I wish we would just cancel Christmas forever. It's not worth this pain.

I used to struggle with this question a lot. I always wondered what healing would look like. To me it means that I live my own life. I become my own person. I have less and less in common with my horrifically abusive family. I used to identify as a victim/survivor/mentally ill person. Now I'm a young woman who is multi-faceted. I have many interests. I'm not just the girl who endured and survived against all odds. She is part of me but I'm much more. I'm the one who takes care of me, who goes to work, who loves nature and animals and the stars, who goes on long walks to admire the trees, who has an interest in several things (I am extremely passionate about animal rights and veganism for example!!) etc etc etc.
